test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

My daughter said, “Ayush has got a packet of toffee for his friends.”

options.text: My daughter said that Ayush has had got a packet of toffee for his friends.
My daughter said that Ayush has got a packet of toffee for his friends.
My daughter said that Ayush had got a packet of toffee for his friends.
My daughter said that Ayush has been got a packet of toffee for his friends.

solution:
The correct answer is **"My daughter said that Ayush had got a packet of toffee for his friends."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The rules for changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:
 
 
• The given sentence is in the Present Perfect Tense.
 
• Present Perfect Tense changes to Past Perfect Tense.
 
• The reporting verb said/said to is changed to told, asked, demanded, ordered, enquired as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• Remove the commas and inverted commas.
 
• The first person in the reported speech changes according to the subject of reporting speech.
 
• Use that in the sentence of indirect speech.
 
• Structure:
 
 
• Subject + has/have + V3 (Direct Speech)
 
• Subject + had + V3 (Indirect Speech)
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Isha said, “I have bought a book .”** *(Direct speech)
 
• *Isha said that she had bought a book.* (Indirect speech)
 
 
 
 
 
• In this case,** "has got"** becomes** "had got"** because the reported statement is in the past and Ayush no longer has the packet of toffee.
 
• The word** "for" **remains the same in indirect speech.
 
• The pronoun **"his" **also remains the same in indirect speech.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
